tasks.label: CMake: Configure
args: [ -n "$BOOST_ROOT" ] || BOOST_ROOT=/opt/boost_1_79_0; [ -r "$BOOST_ROOT/boost/version.hpp" ] || [ -r "$BOOST_ROOT/include/boost/version.hpp" ] || { echo "ERROR: no readable boost/version.hpp under $BOOST_ROOT. See Troubleshooting 3b (Found unsuitable version 0.0.0) in ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md."; exit 1; }; cmake -S . -B cmake_build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DBOOST_ROOT="$BOOST_ROOT" -DNGEN_WITH_TESTS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_NETCDF:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_SQLITE:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_UDUNITS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_C:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_FORTRAN:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_PYTHON:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_MPI:BOOL=OFF
tasks.detail: Configures the default build: matches ngen CI's test_unit job (NetCDF/UDUNITS/SQLite on, BMI-C/Python/MPI off). Falls back to /opt/boost_1_79_0 if BOOST_ROOT is unset, and fails fast with a readable message if the Boost it points at has no version.hpp. See ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md to enable the optional components.

tasks.label: Setup: Python venv (numpy<2)
args: python3 -m venv .venv-linux && .venv-linux/bin/pip install --quiet --upgrade pip && .venv-linux/bin/pip install --quiet "numpy<2.0" && git submodule update --init --recursive -- extern/pybind11 && echo -n "venv ready: numpy " && .venv-linux/bin/python -c "import numpy;print(numpy.__version__)"
tasks.detail: One-time setup for any NGEN_WITH_PYTHON=ON build: creates a container-side virtualenv at .venv-linux with numpy<2.0 (CMakeLists.txt rejects numpy>=2.0.0) and initializes the extern/pybind11 submodule. Deliberately NOT named .venv: a .venv created on a macOS host is bind-mounted into the container but its binaries cannot run there. The Python configure tasks activate this venv themselves; activate it yourself too (source .venv-linux/bin/activate) before running an ngen built with embedded Python, since CMake binds to the interpreter present at configure time.

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Full: BMI-C + Python)
args: [ -x .venv-linux/bin/python ] || { echo "ERROR: no .venv-linux in the workspace. Run the Setup: Python venv (numpy<2) task first — NGEN_WITH_PYTHON=ON needs a venv with numpy<2.0, and a Command Palette task does not inherit one from your terminal."; exit 1; }; . .venv-linux/bin/activate; [ -n "$BOOST_ROOT" ] || BOOST_ROOT=/opt/boost_1_79_0; [ -r "$BOOST_ROOT/boost/version.hpp" ] || [ -r "$BOOST_ROOT/include/boost/version.hpp" ] || { echo "ERROR: no readable boost/version.hpp under $BOOST_ROOT. See Troubleshooting 3b (Found unsuitable version 0.0.0) in ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md."; exit 1; }; cmake -S . -B cmake_build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DBOOST_ROOT="$BOOST_ROOT" -DNGEN_WITH_TESTS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_NETCDF:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_SQLITE:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_UDUNITS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_C:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_FORTRAN:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_PYTHON:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_MPI:BOOL=OFF
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: also enables BMI-C (pulls in TOPMODEL/CFE/PET/LGAR extern models) and embedded Python (which turns NGEN_WITH_ROUTING on too). Activates .venv-linux itself, so run the Setup: Python venv (numpy<2) task once first; without it CMake fails with Could NOT find Python (missing: Python_NumPy_INCLUDE_DIRS NumPy).

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (BMI-C + Fortran/Noah)
args: [ -n "$BOOST_ROOT" ] || BOOST_ROOT=/opt/boost_1_79_0; [ -r "$BOOST_ROOT/boost/version.hpp" ] || [ -r "$BOOST_ROOT/include/boost/version.hpp" ] || { echo "ERROR: no readable boost/version.hpp under $BOOST_ROOT. See Troubleshooting 3b (Found unsuitable version 0.0.0) in ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md."; exit 1; }; cmake -S . -B cmake_build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DBOOST_ROOT="$BOOST_ROOT" -DNGEN_WITH_TESTS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_NETCDF:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_SQLITE:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_UDUNITS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_C:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_FORTRAN:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_PYTHON:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_MPI:BOOL=OFF
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: BMI-C plus BMI-Fortran, which also turns on Noah-OWP-Modular (NGEN_WITH_EXTERN_NOAH_OWP_MODULAR defaults ON whenever NGEN_WITH_BMI_FORTRAN is ON). Needs no setup task and no venv — gfortran is in the image and CMake clones the nested extern/noah-owp-modular submodule itself at configure time. BMI-C is ON because Noah's shipped realization configs are bmi_multi with SLoTH/PET/CFE; Python is OFF because Noah needs nothing from it. Note: the test_bmi_fortran/test_bmi_c targets do not currently compile (pre-existing forcing_params arity mismatch in the test sources), so build the ngen target with this configure, not the test suites.

tasks.label: Setup: Build Boost with serialization (UEB)
args: [ -n "$BOOST_ROOT" ] || BOOST_ROOT=/opt/boost_1_79_0; cd "$BOOST_ROOT" && ./bootstrap.sh --with-libraries=serialization && ./b2 install --prefix=/opt/boost-built && [ -r /opt/boost-built/include/boost/version.hpp ] && echo "Boost install complete." || { echo "ERROR: b2 install did not complete — /opt/boost-built/include/boost/version.hpp is missing. Re-run this task; a partial install makes every configure fail with Boost version 0.0.0."; exit 1; }
tasks.detail: One-time setup for UEB: builds and installs a compiled Boost (with the serialization component) to /opt/boost-built. The default image only has Boost headers at $BOOST_ROOT. Slow — let it finish; it verifies version.hpp landed, because an interrupted b2 install leaves early-alphabet headers behind and every later configure then fails with Found unsuitable version 0.0.0. Run this once before using the UEB configure task.

tasks.label: Setup: Build and install EWTS (UEB)
args: [ -n "$BOOST_ROOT" ] || BOOST_ROOT=/opt/boost_1_79_0; apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libopenmpi-dev openmpi-bin && cmake -B /tmp/ewts-build -S extern/ewts -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DEWTS_WITH_NGEN=ON -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-I$BOOST_ROOT" && cmake --build /tmp/ewts-build -j $(nproc) && cmake --install /tmp/ewts-build --prefix /opt/ewts
tasks.detail: One-time setup for UEB: installs the MPI dev libs (gfortran is already in the image), then builds and installs EWTS (UEB's hard find_package(ewts) dependency) to /opt/ewts. Configures from extern/ewts (the root CMakeLists.txt with the real project()/VERSION), not extern/ewts/runtime as upstream's INSTALL.md says — the runtime-only configure has no project() and fails at write_basic_package_version_file. Also passes Boost's headers via CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS since EWTS's ngen bridge includes boost/property_tree but never calls find_package(Boost) itself. Run this once before using the UEB configure task, after the Boost setup task.

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (BMI-C + UEB)
args: [ -r /opt/boost-built/include/boost/version.hpp ] || { echo "ERROR: /opt/boost-built has no readable boost/version.hpp — UEB needs the compiled Boost. Run (or re-run to completion) the Setup: Build Boost with serialization (UEB) task."; exit 1; }; [ -d /opt/ewts ] || { echo "ERROR: /opt/ewts not found. Run the Setup: Build and install EWTS (UEB) task first."; exit 1; }; cmake -S . -B cmake_build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DBOOST_ROOT=/opt/boost-built -DNGEN_WITH_TESTS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_NETCDF:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_SQLITE:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_UDUNITS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_C:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_FORTRAN:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_PYTHON:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_MPI:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_EXTERN_UEB:BOOL=ON -Dewts_DIR=/opt/ewts/lib/cmake/ewts -DCMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0057=NEW -DNETCDF_C_LIB_DIR=/usr/lib/$(gcc -dumpmachine) -DNETCDF_C_INCLUDE_DIR=/usr/include
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: BMI-C plus UEB (bmi_c++ snow model). Python is OFF because UEB needs nothing from it. Requires a compiled Boost (with serialization) installed to /opt/boost-built and EWTS installed to /opt/ewts first — both are checked up front, with a message naming the setup task to run. Also forces CMP0057=NEW and pre-supplies NETCDF_C_LIB_DIR/NETCDF_C_INCLUDE_DIR, working around two bugs in extern/ueb-bmi's own CMakeLists.txt that otherwise break NetCDF detection when NGEN_WITH_NETCDF is on.

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (Everything)
args: [ -x .venv-linux/bin/python ] || { echo "ERROR: no .venv-linux in the workspace. Run the Setup: Python venv (numpy<2) task first."; exit 1; }; [ -r /opt/boost-built/include/boost/version.hpp ] || { echo "ERROR: /opt/boost-built has no readable boost/version.hpp. Run (or re-run to completion) the Setup: Build Boost with serialization (UEB) task."; exit 1; }; [ -d /opt/ewts ] || { echo "ERROR: /opt/ewts not found. Run the Setup: Build and install EWTS (UEB) task first."; exit 1; }; . .venv-linux/bin/activate; cmake -S . -B cmake_build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DBOOST_ROOT=/opt/boost-built -DNGEN_WITH_TESTS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_NETCDF:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_SQLITE:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_UDUNITS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_C:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_FORTRAN:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_PYTHON:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_MPI:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_EXTERN_UEB:BOOL=ON -Dewts_DIR=/opt/ewts/lib/cmake/ewts -DCMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0057=NEW -DNETCDF_C_LIB_DIR=/usr/lib/$(gcc -dumpmachine) -DNETCDF_C_INCLUDE_DIR=/usr/include
tasks.detail: Opt-in configure: every model component this image supports at once — BMI-C (SLoTH/TOPMODEL/CFE/PET/LGAR), BMI-Fortran (Noah-OWP-Modular), UEB (bmi_c++) and embedded Python (which turns routing on). Uses /opt/boost-built as BOOST_ROOT since UEB needs the compiled Boost, and that install serves the rest too. Requires all three setup tasks first (Python venv, Boost, EWTS) — each is checked up front. Not included: MPI (no runtime in the image) and SMP/SoilFreezeThaw (independent NGEN_WITH_EXTERN_SMP/SFT options, untested here). Build with: cmake --build cmake_build --target ngen bmiuebcxx surfacebmi -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: CMake: Configure (if needed)
args: if [ -f cmake_build/CMakeCache.txt ]; then echo "Using the existing cmake_build configuration:"; grep -E "^NGEN_WITH_(BMI_C|BMI_FORTRAN|PYTHON|MPI|EXTERN_UEB):" cmake_build/CMakeCache.txt | sed "s/^/  /"; echo "  (run Clean ngen, or a Configure task, to change it)"; exit 0; fi; echo "No cmake_build/CMakeCache.txt — running the default configure."; [ -n "$BOOST_ROOT" ] || BOOST_ROOT=/opt/boost_1_79_0; [ -r "$BOOST_ROOT/boost/version.hpp" ] || [ -r "$BOOST_ROOT/include/boost/version.hpp" ] || { echo "ERROR: no readable boost/version.hpp under $BOOST_ROOT. See Troubleshooting 3b (Found unsuitable version 0.0.0) in ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md."; exit 1; }; cmake -S . -B cmake_build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -DBOOST_ROOT="$BOOST_ROOT" -DNGEN_WITH_TESTS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_NETCDF:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_SQLITE:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_UDUNITS:BOOL=ON -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_C:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_BMI_FORTRAN:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_PYTHON:BOOL=OFF -DNGEN_WITH_MPI:BOOL=OFF
tasks.detail: Internal helper the Build tasks depend on: runs the default configure only when cmake_build has no CMakeCache.txt yet, and otherwise leaves whatever you configured alone (printing which optional components are on). This is what keeps Cmd+Shift+B from silently reverting an opt-in configure — Fortran/Noah, Python, UEB or Everything — back to the default flags.

tasks.label: Build ngen (CMake)
tasks.detail: Configures (if needed) then builds the ngen driver executable and the test_bmi_cpp shared library the example realization config in data/ loads. NOTE: this re-runs the DEFAULT configure first, so after an opt-in configure task (Fortran/Noah, Python, UEB, Everything) build from a terminal instead: cmake --build cmake_build --target ngen -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Build test_unit (CMake)
tasks.detail: Configures (if needed) then builds the test_unit and test_geopackage suites (mirrors ngen CI's test_unit job).

tasks.label: Build test binary (CMake)
tasks.detail: Configures (if needed) then builds an arbitrary test target by name. Used as the preLaunchTask for the generic 'Debug a test binary' launch config — see ngen-vscode-dev-setup.md.

tasks.label: Clean ngen
tasks.detail: Removes the cmake_build directory entirely. Also the fix when a configure task picks up stale cached paths from a different configure task — they all share one cmake_build.

tasks.label: Rebuild ngen
tasks.detail: Clean, then a full fresh configure + build.

inputs.description: CMake target name to build, which is also the resulting test binary name under cmake_build/test/ (see test/CMakeLists.txt for the full list, e.g. test_partition, test_nexus, test_geojson, test_mdarray, test_logging). Must match what you enter for the launch config's own prompt.
